items.PAYLOAD: Defines adaptive epistemic system, epistemic state, mechanism, authority/weight, residual, correction/capacity, permeability/reality coupling, grounded reachability/viability, adaptive authority dynamics, restoration, representation expansion, and adaptive intelligence.
Definitions surface gives exponential authority attenuation A_(t+1)=A_t exp[-beta Phi_R(e_t)].
Mechanism decomposition, causal-authority identification, Omega/viability measurement, and restoration/expansion thresholds remain unresolved.

Twelve axioms require reality coupling, measurable mechanism authority, causal consequences of contradiction, empirical reliability tracking, attribution before adaptation, structural influence change, stable authority decay, pressure-gated representation expansion, viability-gated restoration, selection over mechanisms, future viability optimization, and final empirical authority.
Axioms formalize Residual->Attribution->Authority Update->Structural Change and dOmega/dt<=Theta C.
Axioms collectively define a theoretical/normative architecture that repeatedly privileges empirical viability and environmental consequence over internal preference or coherence.
Measurement of authority, empirical reliability-to-authority mapping, causal attribution requirements, and validation of stability/expansion/restoration/selection/viability axioms remain unresolved.

Formal system state, mechanism structure, nonnegative authority distribution, residual/attribution equations, exponential attenuation, authority half-life, restoration function, adaptive stability bound, representation dynamics, and mechanism-selection dynamics.

Mechanism influence is proposed proportional to authority; attenuation is assigned qualitative properties; adaptive intelligence requires the reality-to-authority causal pathway rather than error reduction alone.
RAHU is asserted to test residual detection, attribution accuracy, authority modification, representation change, recurrence reduction, and long-horizon viability.
RAHU is prospectively described as operationalizing the theory through persistent future-behavior measurement after contradiction.
State-coordinate measurement, authority-distribution rules, half-life robustness, restoration function/viability identification, and empirical RAHU operationalization remain unresolved.
